test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.

He said to his friend, “ Let us leave for the trek tomorrow.”

options.text: He suggested to his friend to leave for the trek the next day.
He told his friend to leave for the trek the next day.
He suggested his friend that let us leave for the trek tomorrow.
He suggested to his friend that they should leave for the trek the next day.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, the phrase "Let us leave for the trek tomorrow" is a suggestion.
 
• And it is An imperative narration.
 
• When converting direct speech to indirect speech, **"Let us"** can be changed to "**suggested that they should" **to maintain the meaning.
 
• The word **"tomorrow**" changes to** "the next day"** in indirect speech.

Therefore, the correct indirect form is: **"He suggested to his friend that they should leave for the trek the next day."**
